install.howTitle: Add Flatpare to your Home Screen
install.howAdd: Choose "Add to Home Screen", then Add.
install.howOpen: Open Flatpare from your Home Screen. It opens like an app, without the address bar.
install.howPaste: To add a listing, copy its link, then tap Paste link on the Apartments page.
install.hintShare: Install Flatpare to add apartments from other apps.
install.hintPaste: Add Flatpare to your Home Screen, then add listings with Paste link.

usageNotice.title: Data we collect and why
usageNotice.body: Flatpare counts how many PDFs, addresses and listing links each household has processed, and what each credit paid for. The counts are per household, never per person, and never say what was processed. On flatpare.com we review them to check use against what was paid for.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: What works, what does not, what is missing. It goes straight to the person who runs Flatpare.
feedback.namedNote: The email includes your name and email address, so we can reply.
feedback.anonymousNote: The email does not say who you are, and we cannot reply. Our server knows you are signed in while it sends it, and keeps nothing.
feedback.thanks: Thank you, your feedback is on its way.
feedback.busy: Too much feedback today. Please try again tomorrow.
feedback.failed: It could not be sent. Please try again.
